create_image_processor: create a DeepseekVLImageProcessorPil instance with custom size, min_size, and background color settings
preprocess_images: preprocess a list of images with resize, pad-to-square, rescale, and normalize steps for DeepseekVL model input
resize_image: resize an image so its largest side matches a target size while enforcing a minimum dimension floor
pad_to_square: pad a non-square image to a square by centering it with a configurable background color
test_deepseek_vl_processor: test the DeepseekVLImageProcessorPil pipeline end-to-end with a sample image input
